newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Lauda to raise air fares 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Lauda to raise air fares 4 pct.

text.p: Austrian airline Lauda said on Monday it planned to raise air fares for scheduled flights by four percent from November 1 in response to higher jet fuel costs.
"Economically it is no longer possible to maintain current ticket prices," Lauda Air Luftfahrt AG said in a statement.
The airline noted that the cost of jet had jumped more than 50 percent over the past year.
"I am sure that other airlines will follow the example of British Airways and KLM," the firm's founder Niki Lauda said.
KLM Royal Dutch Airlines and British Airways announced earlier this month that they were hiking air fares. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
